scope.purpose: Operationalize ISO 19650-2:2018 5.3.4 by aggregating the capability and capacity assessments produced by each task team under 5.3.3 into a traceable delivery-team summary.
scope.boundary: This workflow aggregates task-team evidence. It does not perform a substitute task-team assessment, invent missing evidence, or assign the prospective lead appointed party function to a TIVERIT job title.

iso_alignment.input_source: ISO 19650-2:2018 5.3.3 task-team capability and capacity assessments

task_team_assessments.rule: Each source assessment remains separately identifiable and traceable after aggregation.

prospective_lead_appointed_party_mapping.rule: A TIVERIT role or platform permission shall not be assumed to establish this ISO function.

process.rule: Establish the set of task teams represented in the proposed delivery team.

For every identified task team, verify traceable 5.3.3 evidence for information management, information production and IT availability. Missing evidence remains unresolved and shall not be converted into a positive capability statement.
Summarize delivery-team capability to manage information from the underlying task-team evidence while preserving material limitations and dependencies.
Summarize delivery-team capability to produce information from the underlying task-team evidence while preserving material limitations and dependencies.
Summarize delivery-team capacity for timely delivery using task-team staffing/capacity and IT availability evidence. Do not infer schedule adequacy from headcount or technology alone.
Record the aggregated outcome, unresolved items, limitations, source task-team assessment references and the project evidence establishing the prospective lead appointed party function.

result_model.pass: All identified task teams have sufficient source evidence and the aggregation supports the three required delivery-team summary dimensions.
result_model.unresolved: Required task-team evidence, task-team identity, or prospective lead appointed party mapping is incomplete.
result_model.gap: The aggregation omits a required summary dimension or fails to preserve source traceability.
result_model.fail: The summary contradicts available source evidence or represents unsupported/invented capability or capacity as established.

conformance_rules.rule: A 5.3.4 delivery-team summary shall reference the 5.3.3 assessment for every identified task team.
The delivery-team summary shall separately address capability to manage information, capability to produce information, and capacity for timely information delivery.
Aggregation shall not erase or override material limitations, missing evidence, capacity constraints or IT constraints recorded by a source task team.
A delivery-team-level assertion shall not substitute for missing task-team 5.3.3 assessments.
The actor compiling the 5.3.4 summary shall be mapped to the prospective lead appointed party function through project evidence; TIVERIT job title alone is insufficient.

outputs.downstream_use: ISO 19650-2:2018 5.3.7 tender-response capability and capacity assessment summary component

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-003 5.3.4 pass. Establishes aggregation as a distinct prospective-lead-appointed-party activity and preserves the 5.3.3 task-team assessments as source evidence.
